description: Redes de control superficiales: Estaciones de Aforo ROEA en ríos y canales is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Confederación Hidrográfica del Júcar. Information related to the Official Network of Capacity Stations (R.O.E.A.) that allows to know the evolution of flows in singular points of channels and channels. Coverage: Confederación Hidrográfica del Júcar. The portal shows the English title as "Surface control networks: ROEA Capacity Stations in Rivers and Canals" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Confederación Hidrográfica del Júcar. Its keywords include Vigilancia ambiental, Agua, Redes de Control. The listing shows 2023-02-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://datos.gob.es/?q=aviso-legal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
